values.text:
Hi {{first_name}},

Summer has a way of making the everyday feel like an adventure. The days are longer, the plans are looser, and there is always time for one more story.

This week: a little time outdoors, a small moment of independence, and something cold at the end of a very good day.

The best family stories
start a little off the map.
A muddy trail. A wrong turn. A picnic that becomes a rain dance. Sometimes the memories that last are the ones you never planned.

“The days don’t have to be perfect
to become the ones we remember.”

A little freedom.
A whole new world.
The first solo ride down the block. The first order at the café. Small acts of independence are big milestones. Here’s how to make room for them.
Twenty small things to try before the season slips away.
Five easy adventures for your next free afternoon.
A few ways to turn good days into lasting memories.

A sunshine slush
for the whole table.
Citrus, crushed ice, and a little patience. Our favorite alcohol-free summer refresher is as simple as it is good.
You’re receiving this because you signed up for updates.

values.preheaderText: A long-form cream editorial with a serif masthead, blue section ribbons, reading cards, and a summer recipe.
